messages:
Ivy Nguyen: QA hit a weird one on our React Native WebView sample: streamed responses sometimes render out of logical order after the app is backgrounded and then foregrounded. Not a TCP reorder (network trace shows A->B->C), but UI shows B then A then C.

Carlos Vega: hmm. are we doing per-chunk setState calls? React batching could re-order renders if handlers are asynchronous. Also WebView suspends timers/tasks while backgrounded which can change microtask timing.

Ivy Nguyen: repro steps attached in the ticket: open streaming chat, background the app for ~4s, foreground -> UI shuffle. Only on Android WebView (Chromium). Node + desktop browser fine.

Ria Shah: other possible cause: chunk boundaries get merged on resume and our parser treats one chunk == one message. If chunk A and B merge into [A+B] and we naively parse, we can produce partial events then finish with earlier fragments.

Carlos Vega: actionable fixes: 
- Never assume chunk == message; always parse by delimiter (SSE/event delimiter) and maintain a byte-level leftover buffer. 
- Use streaming TextDecoder (TextDecoder.decode(value, {stream:true})) so multi-byte UTF-8 sequences split across chunks decode correctly. 
- Internally queue parsed events in arrival order and flush to UI synchronously to preserve order. Avoid async microtask per chunk that can interleave.

Ivy Nguyen: QA also saw a separate issue where aborting the stream via AbortController during a decode left leftover bytes that were discarded. They wanted that data saved to logs.

Ria Shah: SDK proposal: on abort/close if there are leftover bytes that didn't form a full event, emit an `incomplete` diagnostic event and attach a hex/base64 dump of leftover bytes. Also emit final `status` + `headers` when stream ends so apps can distinguish 401 HTML error bodies mid-stream vs normal close.

Carlos Vega: retry semantics: do not auto-retry if any non-empty payload has been delivered to the app. That produces duplicates. For resumable flows, provide explicit resume token / last_event_id support and a client API `resumeFrom(token)`. Default autoRetryStreaming: 'none'.

Ivy Nguyen: docs & samples: add a small React Native WebView sample demonstrating correct reassembly (buffer+delimiter+flush on rAF) and a note about backgrounding caveats. Also add a tiny e2e that simulates pause/resume.

Ria Shah: QA action items: attach trace + recording to INF-2110. SDK work: reliableStream helper that exposes ordered events, stream-aware TextDecoder, idle timeout config, abort diagnostics.

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-2110 "rn-webview: streaming reorder + abort diagnostics" and added assignees Ivy, Carlos, Ria.

Ivy Nguyen: Temp workaround for customers: buffer all incoming chunks into an array and process/flush on requestAnimationFrame; use TextDecoder with {stream:true}; do not JSON.parse until delimiter seen.

Carlos Vega: I'll start a small PR for the SDK helper and a changelog note about not auto-retrying streaming requests (ETA: this sprint).

Ria Shah: I'll add tests for merged-chunk boundaries and leftover-byte diagnostics.

Ivy Nguyen: thanks everyone — ping when the RN sample PR lands so QA can re-run.
